A1.justification: Both complete 25-page PDFs describe SAMBA and include Appendices A-H. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the methods, equations, tables, figures, and supplementary material.

before.justification: v2 reports original model-training evaluations, downstream benchmark scores, length-extrapolation and retrieval experiments, throughput measurements, and architectural ablations.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results throughout Sections 3-4 and the appendices, including benchmark tables, retrieval experiments, and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: The interleaved Mamba, sliding-window attention, and MLP architecture and its procedures remain unchanged. Removing '(preview)' from Samba-3.8B-IT is a naming edit; Section 3.1 retains both original and June post-training recipes.

E1.justification: Training corpora, evaluation datasets, and task coverage are retained. MMLU and MMLU-Pro already appear in both versions; the introduction's switch between them highlights existing evaluations rather than changing coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership remains unchanged across corresponding experiments. Phi-3-mini already appears in Table 1, and the broader comparisons remain in Table 8. The newly cited Yang et al. (2024) work is not added as an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Model scales, training budgets, evaluation metrics, prompting, sample sizes, and testing procedures are unchanged. The introduction's matched-training statement describes the existing Phi-3 comparison already documented in Section 3.1.

E4.justification: Architectural ablations, attention-head experiments, entropy analyses, retrieval-training analyses, and supplementary studies are retained. Section 4 newly mentions the SWA training analysis in Appendix D, but that analysis and Table 9 already exist in v2.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the ten-repeat throughput averaging in Section 3.3 and the approximately +/-0.3% SlimPajama perplexity fluctuation statements. No repeated-run information, uncertainty reporting, or statistical procedures change.

E6.justification: All experimental results are retained. The introduction switches from Table 8's June-model scores (47.9 MMLU-Pro, 70.1 HumanEval, 86.4 GSM8K) to Table 1's original-recipe scores (71.9 MMLU, 62.8 HumanEval, 87.6 GSM8K). Both result sets are unchanged in their respective tables; these are different highlighted evaluations, not updated measurements.

T1.justification: The Mamba equations in Section 2.1.1 and entropy definitions in Appendix E are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, propositions, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The introduction replaces its highlighted claim of outperforming open-source models up to 8B parameters with a more specific claim of outperforming Phi-3-mini under matched training recipes and datasets. Broader comparisons remain in Appendix B, and the architecture, extrapolation, and efficiency claims are retained.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, result interpretations, and limitations remain unchanged, including weaknesses in zero-shot retrieval, limited cross-task transfer, and task-dependent architectural advantages. The controlled-comparison qualification emphasized in the introduction was already documented elsewhere.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware descriptions, data processing, generation settings, and code-access information remain unchanged, including Appendices C, F, and G. The model-label edit does not establish a release or availability change.

R1.justification: v3 adds Yang et al. (2024), 'Parallelizing linear transformers with the delta rule over sequence length,' to Section 3.2 and the references. The substantive related-work discussion and novelty positioning in Appendix A remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Edits are localized: the introduction reframes its benchmark summary, '(preview)' is removed from the instruction-tuned model name, Section 4 expands its Appendix D pointer, and publication headers are updated. Section organization and appendix structure remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 1's caption and model label lose '(preview)', producing minor reflow and table-width changes. Publication headers are updated. All eight figures and twelve tables retain their placement and substantive displays.

improvement.justification: Foregrounding the matched-training Phi-3-mini comparison in the introduction makes the headline performance argument more carefully scoped, while preserving the broader evidence in Appendix B. The added citation and clearer pointer to the existing SWA analysis provide small contextual and navigation gains. These are limited improvements; the methods, empirical evidence, and limitations are unchanged.
